description: This file defines the MysqlManager class, which provides a MySQL-specific implementation of database management operations for the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for connecting to the database, executing queries, managing table schemas, and handling MySQL-specific features like character sets, collations, indexes, and constraints.

classes.name: MysqlManager
classes.description: This class manages MySQL-specific database operations, including connection handling, query execution, schema creation and alteration, and special handling for MySQL features like fulltext search and character encodings.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, handling both string and array input, and manages logging and error checking.

methods.name: getAffectedRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: freeDbResult
methods.description: Frees the database result resource.

methods.name: hasLimit
methods.description: Checks if an SQL query contains a LIMIT clause.

methods.name: limitQuery
methods.description: Adds a LIMIT clause to a query and executes it.

methods.name: checkQuery
methods.description: Performs an EXPLAIN on a query to identify potential performance issues like full table scans or missing indexes.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Describes a table's columns, returning their types, lengths, defaults, and auto-increment status.

methods.name: getFieldsArray
methods.description: Returns the list of field names from a MySQL result set.

methods.name: fetchRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row from a result set as an associative array.

methods.name: getTablesArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of all tables in the current database.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the MySQL server version.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific table exists in the database.

methods.name: tablesLike
methods.description: Retrieves tables matching a specific LIKE pattern.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL statements.

methods.name: quoteIdentifier
methods.description: Quotes a database identifier (e.g., table or column name).

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using provided configuration options.

methods.name: repairTableParams
methods.description: Generates and executes SQL for repairing table parameters, optimizing ALTER TABLE operations.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a value into a specific SQL expression, such as date functions or string concatenation.

methods.name: fromConvert
methods.description: Converts a string from a database expression (simple passthrough here).

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Retrieves the storage engine for a specific bean, based on its dictionary definition.

methods.name: isEngineEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific storage engine (e.g., InnoDB, MyISAM) is supported/enabled.

methods.name: createTableSQL
methods.description: Generates a CREATE TABLE SQL statement for a given bean.

methods.name: createTableSQLParams
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating a table with specific parameters, including engine and charset.

methods.name: isTextType
methods.description: Determines if a column type is a text-based type.

methods.name: oneColumnSQLRep
methods.description: Generates the SQL fragment for defining a single column in a CREATE or ALTER TABLE statement.

methods.name: changeColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for changing or dropping columns.

methods.name: keysSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for index and constraint definitions inside CREATE TABLE.

methods.name: setAutoIncrement
methods.description: Placeholder for setting auto-increment on a column.

methods.name: setAutoIncrementStart
methods.description: Sets the next auto-increment value for a table.

methods.name: getAutoIncrement
methods.description: Retrieves the next auto-increment value for a table.

methods.name: get_indices
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a table.

methods.name: add_drop_constraint
methods.description: Generates SQL to add or drop constraints (indexes, primary keys, foreign keys).

methods.name: fetchOne
methods.description: Executes a query and fetches a single row.

methods.name: full_text_indexing_installed
methods.description: Checks if full-text indexing is available (requires MyISAM engine).

methods.name: massageFieldDef
methods.description: Adjusts a field definition array for compatibility with MySQL.

methods.name: dropTableNameSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a table if it exists.

methods.name: dropIndexes
methods.description: Drops indexes from a table.

methods.name: getCollation
methods.description: Retrieves the collation setting for the current connection.

methods.name: getCharset
methods.description: Retrieves the charset setting for the current connection.

methods.name: getDefaultCollation
methods.description: Returns the default collation used if none is specified.

methods.name: getDefaultCharset
methods.description: Returns the default charset used if none is specified.

methods.name: getCollationList
methods.description: Lists available collations from the server.

methods.name: renameColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to rename a column.

methods.name: emptyValue
methods.description: Provides default null/empty values for specific data types.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Returns the last database error message.

methods.name: quoteTerm
methods.description: Quotes a search term for full-text search.

methods.name: getFulltextQuery
methods.description: Builds a boolean full-text search query string.

methods.name: getCharsetInfo
methods.description: Lists character set variables from MySQL.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Returns info about the database server, version, and configuration.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Performs an EXPLAIN on a query to validate it.

methods.name: makeTempTableCopy
methods.description: Creates a temporary copy of a table for testing schema changes.

methods.name: verifyAlterTable
methods.description: Tests an ALTER TABLE statement on a temporary copy.

methods.name: verifyGenericReplaceQuery
methods.description: Tests a data modification query (DROP, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on a temp table.

methods.name: verifyDropTable
methods.description: Tests a DROP TABLE statement.

methods.name: verifyInsertInto
methods.description: Tests an INSERT statement.

methods.name: verifyUpdate
methods.description: Tests an UPDATE statement.

methods.name: verifyDeleteFrom
methods.description: Tests a DELETE statement.

methods.name: dbExists
methods.description: Checks if a database exists.

methods.name: selectDb
methods.description: Switches the current database.

methods.name: userExists
methods.description: Checks if a MySQL user exists.

methods.name: createDbUser
methods.description: Creates a new MySQL user with privileges.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database with charset and collation.

methods.name: dropDatabase
methods.description: Drops a database.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the MySQL PHP extension is available.

methods.name: canInstall
methods.description: Checks MySQL version requirements for installation.

methods.name: installConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration options for database setup.

methods.name: disableKeys
methods.description: Disables indexes/keys on a table to speed up bulk operations.

methods.name: enableKeys
methods.description: Re-enables indexes/keys on a table.

methods.name: getFromDummyTable
methods.description: Returns a dummy FROM clause if needed (empty string here).

methods.name: getGuidSQL
methods.description: Provides SQL expression to generate UUIDs.
